title: Aureline M5 safe-explanation-banner component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the safe-explanation-banner family binds inside the frozen M5 learning-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-learning-component-matrix.schema.json). A safe explanation banner names how it separates explain from do and what it will actually apply so an educational explanation never widens mutating authority and applies nothing without the same preview and approval model as ordinary work. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-learning is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
